resources.string: Create a project from TXT or open a .lnt file. TXT originals can be up to 8 MiB.
No projects yet. Choose a TXT or .lnt file to begin.
Existing library data is preserved. Migration to projects is not available yet.
%1$d project folders need recovery. Existing projects are preserved.
The private project could not be opened. Refresh or import a saved copy.
Agent chat is not available in this build. You can edit text and save your project.
Automatic translation is not connected yet. Manual editing and export are available.
Only processed entries use their saved translation, including empty text. Other entries use the original. Identical original and translated lines are shown once in bilingual output.
This asset has no text entries. The original file is preserved.
Operation cancelled. Refresh to check any changes already saved.
The saved entry has changed. Your draft is preserved. Reload the saved value before trying again.
Your unsaved changes will be lost.
The file or text exceeds the supported limit.
The text cannot be decoded. Check the selected encoding.
This project version is not supported.
This file is not a supported LNT TXT project, or its contents are damaged.
The operation could not finish. Existing project data is preserved.
Another operation is still running. Try again after it finishes.
Access to the selected file was denied. Select the file again.
Temporary exports cleared. Saved projects are unchanged.

This is a local workflow test, not a real translation. It writes [SIMULATION] plus the original text into nonblank, unprocessed entries on this page only. Saved and excluded entries stay unchanged. Duplicate your project first if needed. No network or paid requests are made.
Local simulation finished. Saved results are kept.
Local workflow buttons use Koog without network access. Configure a remote model for conversation. The manual proposal form tests approval and does not generate model text.
One entry will be replaced with the proposed translation and marked processed. Approval applies once to this fixed difference.
The result is unresolved. Refresh to check the project receipt; it will not execute automatically.

Enter the HTTPS API base URL including /v1 when required. Chat Completions compatible text/tools only. The key is encrypted on this device. Saving does not send a request. Enter the key again to change configuration.
Configure a model to send messages. Local workflow buttons work without a model.
Sending shares this conversation and requested project text with your provider and may incur charges. Proposed edits still require approval.
Model authentication failed. Check the configuration. No automatic retry.
The model request failed or timed out. No automatic retry; the request may have reached the provider.
The provider is busy or rate limited. No automatic retry.
Conversation budget exceeded. Start a new chat.
The model response was incomplete or invalid. Saved project results are kept.
The request result needs reconciliation. It will not be sent again automatically.
Conversation history is incomplete or invalid. Start a new chat; existing records are kept.
Some Agent data could not be verified. Refresh or reopen the project. Approval and sending are disabled until verification succeeds.
Check the HTTPS API base address, model name and API key. The address must not contain credentials, a query or a fragment; the key must use printable ASCII without spaces.
